bifrost: springboard/apps/files/src (window.rs, menus.rs, keys.rs, views/, sidebar.rs, info.rs, smart.rs, search.rs, ops.rs, go.rs, server.rs, dragout.rs, system.rs, tabs.rs, undo.rs)
